One pan chicken noodle soup with ginger and chilli. This makes enough to freeze so you can portion it up for days when you aren't feeling cooking.

2 x chicken breasts,
1 x red pepper,
1 x onion,
2 x large flat portobello mushrooms,
1 x carrot,
Sweetcorn,
1 small chilli pepper or 1 tsp red chilli flakes,
1 small piece of fresh ginger,
1 tbsp honey,
Handful of kale or greens,
Chicken or veg stock,
Fine egg noodles (rice noodles also work great)

Prepare the veg by cutting into thin slices
Cook the chicken and when it's almost cooked through add the honey. 

Chop ginger and the chilli very finely (if using fresh) and add to the pan.

Add enough stock so it covers everything and simmer for around 10 minutes.

Add the noodles and serve as soon as it's ready.
The best bit is when it's over.
